verses.text: A Song for the Ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills, from where my help does come.

segments.text: A Song for the Ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills, from where my help does come.

verses.text: My help [is] from YHWH, the Maker of the heavens and the earth.

segments.text: My help [is] from YHWH, the Maker of the heavens and the earth.

verses.text: He will not give your foot to the slipping; the One guarding you will not slumber.

segments.text: He will not give your foot to the slipping; the One guarding you will not slumber.

verses.text: Behold, He does not slumber, and He does not sleep—the One guarding Israel.

segments.text: Behold, He does not slumber, and He does not sleep—the One guarding Israel.

verses.text: YHWH [is] the One guarding you; YHWH [is] your shade on your right hand.

segments.text: YHWH [is] the One guarding you; YHWH [is] your shade on your right hand.

verses.text: By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon in the night.

segments.text: By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon in the night.

verses.text: YHWH will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul.

segments.text: YHWH will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul.

verses.text: YHWH will guard your going out and your coming in, from now even to forever.
